summary: Moved all date/time parsing into deskstats/timeparse.py and rewired site, tickets, escalations, calls, chats, roster, closures, cli and report to use it; tests pass (also under TZ=Asia/Tokyo) and tests/test_timeparse.py was added. Chats keep nearest-even rounding (NEAREST_EVEN), not the TRUNCATE the guide's table lists, to leave reports unchanged; the original's uncaught OverflowError crashes (e.g. inf in calls/chats, huge roster years) are preserved by the callers.
